verdict.rationale: Polar's official remote MCP server lets agents "take actions across your products", and a Checkout Session API supports API-driven checkout flows, so an agent can plausibly provision products and generate checkout URLs in one session. However, the documented Checkout Links are configured in the dashboard, and no evidence explicitly shows API endpoints for creating a product with its price or a reusable payment link. missing for 10: explicit documented API/MCP creation of products and prices, API creation of checkout/payment links, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent provisioning flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Agents can look up data and take actions across your products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits, and more.
If you want to integrate more deeply the checkout process with your website or application, you can use our dedicated API.
the Checkout Session API (session.md) for fully API-driven flows
Call the Polar API with full type safety using one of our official SDKs.
